newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germans catch women with cocaine under wonky wigs.
newsitem.headline: Germans catch women with cocaine under wonky wigs.

text.p: German customs officials said on Friday they caught four Jamaican women trying to smuggle 4.7 kg cocaine into the country hidden under wigs perched on top of their heads in a suspicious manner.
The officials at Duesseldorf airport said they had confiscated the drugs which had a street value of 700,000 marks and detained the women.

In a separate operation, Cologne airport drugs squad detained three suspected drugs traffickers and seized 30 kg of cocaine hidden inside cargoes of electrical cable in two air freighters from Venezuela bound for Barcelona and Vienna.
